premise: Four tiny friends each bring one tiny thing to a picnic, a drop of honey, a crumb, a seed and a petal cup, and together it is a feast on a pinecone table.
inspiration: Stone Soup (folk), turned tiny: no trickery needed, everyone brings a little and it adds up to plenty.
lesson: A little from everyone makes plenty.

en-US.title: The Tiny Picnic
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Picnic! said Bee. Everybody bring something. But everybody was small, so everybody brought something small. Bee {bee:hop} brought one drop of honey. That's one. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} brought one crumb of bread, That's two. Acorn {acorn:wobble x2} rolled up with one sunflower seed. That's three. And Pinecone? Pinecone {pinecone:spin} lay down flat on the moss. I'm the table, she said. That's four! Hmm, said Ladybug. It's not very much. Bee dipped the crumb in the honey. Ladybug balanced the seed on top. Acorn found a petal and filled it with dew. {pinecone:sparkle} Oh, said Acorn. Look. It was a feast. A tiny, shining, perfect feast. They ate every bit, and when they were done, they lay back on the table and looked at the sky. {bee:hearts} Same time tomorrow? said Bee. Everybody bring something small.

es-ES.title: El pícnic chiquitín
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} ¡Pícnic!, dijo Abeja. Que cada uno traiga algo. Pero todos eran pequeños, así que todos trajeron algo pequeño. Abeja {bee:hop} trajo una gota de miel. Va una. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} trajo una miga de pan, Van dos. Bellota {acorn:wobble x2} llegó rodando con una pipa de girasol. Van tres. ¿Y Piña? Piña {pinecone:spin} se tumbó en el musgo. Yo soy la mesa, dijo. ¡Van cuatro! Mmm, dijo Mariquita. No es mucho. Abeja mojó la miga en la miel. Mariquita puso la pipa encima. Bellota encontró un pétalo y lo llenó de rocío. {pinecone:sparkle} Oh, dijo Bellota. Mirad. Era un banquete. Un banquete chiquitín, brillante y perfecto. Se lo comieron todo, y al terminar se tumbaron en la mesa a mirar el cielo. {bee:hearts} ¿Mañana otra vez?, dijo Abeja. Que cada uno traiga algo pequeño.
